beats.text: Rama's monkey army stood before Ravana's demon legions. Drums thundered. Conches roared across the plain.
Rama divided his army to attack all four gates of Lanka at once. He took the north gate himself, where Ravana waited.
Rama and Lakshmana led from the front. On the walls, Ravana watched with his ten heads, his twenty eyes burning.
The gates opened, and demons poured out on elephants and chariots, with swords, maces and spears.
The monkeys charged with rocks, trees and bare hands, roaring Rama's name.
The battle raged all day. Blood ran like rivers. When night fell, the demons grew stronger, and still the monkeys fought on.
Demon generals fell one by one to Hanuman, Angada and Sugriva.
But Ravana's son Indrajit was yet to fight. Watching from the clouds, he smiled.
